messages:
Alex B: Quick check — CCS tenant (ccs-42) needs a short overnight burst in ap-southeast1 for a smoke run. Need 4x A100 for ~3h (02:00-05:00 UTC). Who owns quota for that region/tenant?

Mika C: I can check. Last snapshot shows project ccs-42 has 0 reserved A100s, but we have demo/standby pool with spare slots. Could borrow if ops approves.

Sara K: tagging billing/labels: if we borrow from demo pool, please tag with billing:ccs-42 and add label:eviction-window=overnight so we can reconcile cost back to the tenant.

Mika C: ack. Also need to confirm tenant network isolation for private runs — are they running in VPC-shared project or within our infra? If VPC-shared, need a short firewall rule preflight.

Alex B: They run in a customer workspace in prod-vpc-shared. Firewall is fine (already whitelisted). Main blocker is quota + an owner to approve borrowing.

Vikram P: @Mika C I can approve borrowing for up to 6h. Before we pull, can you run the quick quota check? 1-liner we use: ```gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-prod --format='value(quotas)'
# or check our inventory dashboard: https://infra.redwood.internal/pools/demo```
Don't forget to set eviction policy label.

Mika C: ran the gcloud check; current free A100 slots in demo pool: 6. Planned borrow of 4 OK. I'll open the ops ticket and set tags.

Alex B: solid. Please create the ticket and paste the ticket ID here. Also need a short rollback plan if jobs block other canaries.

Mika C: ticket #OPS-4821 created. Details: borrow 4x A100 from demo pool for ccs-42 smoke test 02:00-05:00 UTC, labels=billing:ccs-42, eviction-window=02:00-05:00, owner=Vikram P. Rollback: drain and deallocate within 10m if any canary alerts fire.

Sara K: thanks — I'll schedule cost allocation for the chargeback. Also suggest adding a short note in the console about the ephemeral borrow so support sees it.

Vikram P: I'll monitor during window. @InfraBot can you post a reminder 30m before start and set temporary quota policy in our policy service?

InfraBot: Reminder scheduled for 1719999800 (30m before). Temp quota policy applied: demo-pool -> ccs-42 (4x A100) until 1719999800 + 10800s.

Alex B: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Mika C: post-run, I'll reassign slots back to demo pool and close OPS-4821 with a short blameless note.

Sara K: ping me if any billing anomalies.

Vikram P: closing loop — will drop a short postmortem in #eng-infra if anything went sideways.
